'''José María Asua González''' (Zarátamo, April 6, 1953) is a Spanish chemist, professor of chemical engineering at the University of the Basque Country and director of Polymat, the Polymeric Materials Research Institute.<ref name="ehu2">{{cite web|access-date=11 June 2020 |title=Persona- Jose M. Asua |url=https://www.ehu.eus/es/web/polymat/staff/-/asset_publisher/pu5Y/content/persona-asua-jose-m-?inheritRedirect=falsee |website=Universidad del País Vasco}}<!-- auto-translated from Spanish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

Asua obtained his Bachelor's degree in Chemistry from the University of Bilbao in 1975, and completed his PhD in Chemistry at the [[University of Zaragoza]], researching the deactivation of solid catalysts.<ref name="euskonews">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua / Catedrático de Ingeniería Química |url=http://www.euskonews.eus/0478zbk/elkar_es.html |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Euskonews}}</ref>

== Research and professional career ==
In 1978, he joined the Faculty of Chemical Sciences at the [[University of the Basque Country]] to research the subject of polymerization reactors.<ref name="euskonews">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua / Catedrático de Ingeniería Química |url=http://www.euskonews.eus/0478zbk/elkar_es.html |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Euskonews}}</ref> He completed a post-doctoral stay at the [[University of Liège]] (Belgium) investigating the hydrodynamics of trickle bed reactors (TBR),<ref name="polymat">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asúa |url=http://www.polymat.eu/es/people/group-leaders/jose-m-asua |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Polymat}}</ref> and has spent sabbatical years at Lehigh University (USA) as a Fulbright scholar and at the [[University of Waterloo]] (Canada) as a visiting professor.{{Cn|date=April 2025}}

He is also a visiting professor at the Catholic Universities of Leuven (Belgium) and Dortmund (Germany).<ref name="gepslap">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua |url=https://www.gep-slap2020.eu/conferenciantes-plenarios-jose-maria-asua |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200611105318/https://www.gep-slap2020.eu/conferenciantes-plenarios-jose-maria-asua |archive-date=11 June 2020 |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=GEP-SLAP2020 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Professor Asua has worked in industrially important polymerization processes, developing knowledge-based strategies for the production of water-dispersed polymers.<ref name="euskonews"></ref> He has also been involved in university-industry relations, directing industrial projects; and has been part of the scientific committee of international conferences and director of a NATO Advanced Study Institute.<ref name="jakiunde">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua |url=https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628195043/https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-date=28 June 2022 |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Jakiunde |url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==

* Award for Research Excellence from the [[Spanish Royal Society of Chemistry|Royal Spanish Society of Chemistry]], 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=Claudio Palomo y José Mª Asua, premiados por la Real Sociedad Española de Química |url=https://www.interempresas.net/Quimica/Articulos/185337-Claudio-Palomo-y-Jose-M-Asua-premiados-por-la-Real-Sociedad-Espanola-de-Quimica.html |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Interempresas.net}}</ref>
* Professor Martínez Moreno Award for Invention and Research in Applied Chemistry from the [[University of Seville]] and the García-Cabrerizo Foundation, 2015.<ref name="polymat">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asúa |url=http://www.polymat.eu/es/people/group-leaders/jose-m-asua |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Polymat}}</ref>
* Euskadi Research Award, 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= 8 March 2006|title=El químico de la UPV José María Asúa, premio Euskadi de Investigación |url=https://www.diariovasco.com/pg060308/prensa/noticias/AlDia/200603/08/DVA-ALD-289.html?ref=https:%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=El Diario Vasco}}</ref>
* Member of Jakiunde, the Academy of Sciences, Arts and Letters of the Basque Country.<ref name="jakiunde"></ref>
* Rhône Poulenc Award for Innovation in Clean Technologies.<ref name="jakiunde">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua |url=https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628195043/https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-date=28 June 2022 |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Jakiunde |url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Publications ==
Asua is the author of a book and editor of the books 'Polymeric Dispersions: Principles and Applications' (1997) and 'Polymer Reaction Engineering' (2007). He has published more than 230 articles and is co-author of 4 patents. He is a member of the editorial boards of Macromolecular Reaction Engineering, Macromolecular Materials and Engineering and Chemical Engineering Journal, and has been Associate Editor of Polymer Reaction Engineering. He has directed 33 doctoral theses.<ref name="jakiunde">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=José María Asua |url=https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628195043/https://www.jakiunde.eus/miembros/m/?mid=23&n=Asua-Gonzalez-Jose-M%C2%AA |archive-date=28 June 2022 |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=Jakiunde |url-status=dead}}</ref>
